delivery.title: Delivery & payment
delivery.lead: We deliver across the CIS: Belarus, Russia, Kazakhstan, Armenia, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan and more. Every piece is authenticated and ships in Amfibia packaging.
delivery.pickupNote: Your order waits at a pickup point; tracking shows an “Arrived at pickup point” step.
delivery.doorNote: A courier or carrier brings the order to your address.
delivery.free: Free delivery on orders from {sum} (after promo discount).
delivery.onlineNote: Pay at checkout — the order is confirmed instantly.
delivery.cashNote: Pay on delivery — the order is confirmed; payment is marked on handover.

p: Lead time is order assembly (usually 1 business day) plus transit with the chosen carrier. The expected date is saved with the order and shown on the tracking page.
After checkout you get an order number AMF-YYYY-NNNNNN and a tracking number. The status updates automatically in your account or on the “Track order” page without signing in.
list: Placed → Confirmed → Being assembled → Assembled
Handed to delivery → In transit → (At pickup point) → Delivered

p: Prices are stored in Belarusian roubles and converted to USD and EUR at the Amfibia rate. The rate and total are fixed at checkout — later rate changes do not affect your order.
No customs duties within EAEU duty-free limits. A receipt and an Amfibia authenticity certificate come with every parcel.

returns.title: Returns
returns.lead: If a piece doesn't work out, return it within 14 days of delivery. Filing a request in your account takes a couple of minutes.
steps: Open the order in your account and click “Return item”.
Choose a reason and quantity, and attach a photo if you like.
Support reviews the request within 1–2 business days and notifies you.
Hand the item to a courier or pickup point — after inspection the refund arrives in 3–5 business days.

list: No more than 14 days after delivery.
Unworn, with tags, seals and original packaging.
Complete: dust bags, boxes, cards and the Amfibia certificate.
Fragrance with opened packaging.
Jewellery with personal engraving or resizing.
Underwear and swimwear without the hygiene seal.

p: Refunds go to the original payment method, in the order currency at the checkout rate. If the whole order is returned, its status becomes “Returned” and payment “Refunded”.

sizes.title: Size guide
sizes.lead: European (EU), Italian (IT), American (US) and international (INT) size systems. Each product page has a chart for its own category.

list: Chest — at the fullest point, tape parallel to the floor.
Waist — at the narrowest point, without pulling the tape.
Hips — at the fullest point.
Foot length — heel to big toe, standing, in the evening.

p: Balenciaga and Vetements often cut oversized — if in doubt, take your usual size. Maison Margiela Tabi and Italian shoes follow EU sizing. Chrome Hearts rings use US sizes — check the diameter in the chart.

about.title: About us
about.lead: Amfibia is a luxury fashion marketplace with the feel of a private boutique and a fashion magazine. Fifteen houses — from Loro Piana's quiet luxury to the punk decadence of Enfants Riches Déprimés.

p: An amphibian lives in two worlds. So do we: between haute couture and the street, the archive and the new season.
Every piece is checked: a moderator verifies the description, photos of tags and seams, and supplier documents. The “Verified by Amfibia” mark is given only after the check.
list: Amfibia Official store and vetted sellers
Online only: ordering, payment and delivery across the CIS
14-day returns and seven-day support

p: A piece means more when you know its story. That's why we write a detailed chronicle for every brand — from the founder to the present day.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.lead: A showroom in central Minsk: fittings, stylist advice and order pickup. Write to us — we reply within a business day.

p: Want to sell on Amfibia? Apply in your account (“Become a seller”) — a moderator will review it and open your seller dashboard.
For partnerships and publications — hello@amfibia.by with the subject “Press”.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: How Amfibia collects, stores and protects the personal data of customers and sellers.

list: Name, email and phone — for sign-in and order communication.
Delivery addresses from the address book and a copy in each order.
Order, review, request and notification history.
Technical data: the sign-in session and IP of sign-in attempts (brute-force protection).
Passwords are stored only as bcrypt hashes — nobody knows the password itself.
Sessions use secure cookies (httpOnly, SameSite); forms are protected with a CSRF token.
Sign-in locks for 15 minutes after 5 failed attempts; two-factor authentication is available.
Card numbers are never sent to the server.

p: A seller sees only the customer's first name and city; the warehouse — order contents; a courier — the address and phone for orders assigned to them; support — order and request data. All staff actions are recorded in the audit log.
You can change your data in profile settings, delete addresses and unsubscribe at any time. To delete your account, contact support.
